A conditional Beta split proves the one-dimensional arcsine density without unproved regularity claims. A local exact normal form Y-1/4=q-t^2 with transformed weight 2/(pi sqrt(q)) yields log coefficient 2/pi per each of three edge midpoints. Simplex vertices and the unique interior quadratic maximum yield endpoint tail slopes 3/2 and 9/2. Exact rational Dirichlet moments produce 4/21 and 400/63063. The standalone checker was actually executed from the package and returned VERIFY_OK; finite tests do not prove density/asymptotics, which follow analytically.

The unexpected internal logarithmic caustic, its exact universal coefficient 6/pi, and sharp endpoint slopes distinguish the geometry from the published axial cubic brightness law.
